one_liner: Articles now lock after the third one each day. A game unlocks more.
author: aadi

change.title: Product change: Play one short game to keep reading after your third article today
change.what_is_different_here: Reading is the app's core loop: a story card on the home feed (s01.e59) opens the article reader (s02, s02.e04), and back. The app has no paywall, limit, or currency. A daily article limit gives readers a moment where a short game gets them what they came for.
change.adds: Articles now lock after the third one each day. A game unlocks more.
change.trigger_event: The reader opens a fourth article today; it is locked
change.placement: A lock panel over the fourth article's text
change.frequency_cap: 2 per day, resets at midnight local time
change.offer_copy: You've read your 3 free articles today. Play a quick game to keep reading for the next 30 minutes.
change.decline_path: Tapping the X closes the panel; the article stays locked until midnight, and the feed, saving, and sharing work as before.
change.ad_fail_path: If no game is ready, the lock panel says to come back tomorrow. If the game fails to load or the play is not confirmed, a short note says the articles couldn't be unlocked this time, and the attempt does not count toward the daily 2.
change.subscriber_treatment: No paid plan was observed in the app, so every reader is a free reader; if a paid plan is added later, its members would never see the lock.
change.character_use: None; the panel uses the app's own styling and no story content appears in the ad moment.

flow_steps.caption: The reader has read three articles today and taps a fourth story.
The article opens locked: a panel says the day's 3 free articles are used and offers 30 minutes of reading for one quick game.
The reader plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
Once the play is confirmed, the article unlocks and a small note shows 30 minutes left.

change.after_reward: When the 30 minutes end, articles lock again, with a note that one more game is available today.
change.rationale: Reading is the one thing every reader comes for. A daily limit with a game to lift it turns each extra article into an ad view, and saying no still leaves three free articles a day.
